svg.title: Figure 2 · Every part class's finish
svg.desc: The base colour, metallic and roughness of every part class in each livery
svg.text: 17 part classes with the base colour, metallic and roughness blender_render.py gives each; a livery overrides some of them (military: 10). Swatches are the linear colours
● the livery overrides this class (metallic and roughness shown are the industrial values). Safety and access classes keep a visible colour in every livery.
